figs.name: atm-to-kpa-mercury-barometer-diagram
figs.alt: mercury barometer diagram showing 760 mm column and 1 atm equal to 101.325 kPa
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a 760 mm mercury column and the check P = ρgh = 101,325 Pa, which is why 1 atm equals exactly 101.325 kPa.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Torricelli mercury barometer showing why 1 atm equals 101.325 kPa</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Why 1 atm = 101.325 kPa: the Mercury Column</text>
<path d="M60 400 L60 470 Q60 485 75 485 L345 485 Q360 485 360 470 L360 400" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="62" y="430" width="296" height="53" fill="#9ca3af"/>
<rect x="190" y="80" width="40" height="390" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="193" y="140" width="34" height="328" fill="#9ca3af"/>
<text x="178" y="122" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">Vacuum</text>
<line x1="182" y1="116" x2="205" y2="112" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="130" y="70" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Glass tube</text>
<line x1="160" y1="76" x2="188" y2="92" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<line x1="232" y1="140" x2="272" y2="140" stroke="#92400e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
<line x1="262" y1="143" x2="262" y2="427" stroke="#92400e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-start="url(#ah)" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="272" y="268" width="80" height="30" fill="#ffffff"/>
<text x="312" y="290" font-size="19" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">760 mm</text>
<line x1="95" y1="360" x2="95" y2="424" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="140" y1="360" x2="140" y2="424" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="300" y1="360" x2="300" y2="424" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="338" y1="360" x2="338" y2="424" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="118" y="350" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Atmosphere</text>
<text x="210" y="512" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Mercury at 0°C</text>
<rect x="420" y="80" width="355" height="350" rx="14" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="597" y="118" font-size="21" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hydrostatic check</text>
<text x="597" y="158" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P = ρ × g × h</text>
<text x="445" y="200" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">ρ = 13,595.1 kg/m³</text>
<text x="445" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">g = 9.80665 m/s²</text>
<text x="445" y="264" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">h = 0.760 m</text>
<text x="597" y="310" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">13595.1 × 9.80665 × 0.760</text>
<text x="597" y="345" font-size="22" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">= 101,325 Pa</text>
<text x="597" y="385" font-size="22" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">= 101.325 kPa = 1 atm</text>
<text x="597" y="470" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Made exact by the 10th CGPM in 1954</text>
</svg>

figs.name: atm-to-kpa-conversion-steps-flowchart
figs.alt: atm to kPa conversion flowchart with reverse kPa to atm and gauge to absolute check
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to convert atm to kPa by multiplying by 101.325, kPa to atm by dividing, and when to add 1 atm for absolute pressure.
figs.after_h2: The atm to kPa Conversion Formula
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to convert atm to kPa and kPa to atm with gauge check</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">atm to kPa and Back: Step by Step</text>
<rect x="230" y="55" width="340" height="48" rx="10" fill="#d97706" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="85.65" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which unit do you have?</text>
<line x1="320" y1="103" x2="200" y2="138" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="480" y1="103" x2="600" y2="138" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="140" width="320" height="48" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="170.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Value in atm</text>
<line x1="200" y1="188" x2="200" y2="213" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="215" width="320" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="248.0" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">kPa = atm × 101.325</text>
<line x1="200" y1="267" x2="200" y2="292" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="294" width="320" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="321.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example</text>
<text x="200.0" y="345.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2 atm = 202.65 kPa</text>
<rect x="440" y="140" width="320" height="48" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="170.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Value in kPa</text>
<line x1="600" y1="188" x2="600" y2="213" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="440" y="215" width="320" height="52" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="248.0" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">atm = kPa ÷ 101.325</text>
<line x1="600" y1="267" x2="600" y2="292" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="440" y="294" width="320" height="66" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="321.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example</text>
<text x="600.0" y="345.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">50 kPa = 0.493 atm</text>
<line x1="200" y1="362" x2="375" y2="392" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="600" y1="362" x2="425" y2="392" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,392.0 550.0,440 400,488.0 250.0,440" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="435.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gauge reading,</text>
<text x="400" y="457.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">need absolute?</text>
<line x1="250" y1="440" x2="218" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="236" y="428" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="20" y="405" width="196" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="118.0" y="434.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Done</text>
<text x="118.0" y="458.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">same reference</text>
<line x1="550" y1="440" x2="582" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="566" y="428" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="584" y="405" width="196" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="682.0" y="434.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Add 101.325 kPa</text>
<text x="682.0" y="457.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">kPaa = kPag + 1 atm</text>
<text x="400" y="530" font-size="18" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Use 101.325, not 100: 100 kPa is 1 bar, a 1.3% error</text>
</svg>
